about.title: About Watan-e-Pak
about.subtitle: Pakistan's smart, data-driven property marketplace
about.summary: Two decades of connecting Pakistani families, investors and developers.
body: Watan-e-Pak is a full-stack real-estate portal built for Pakistan. From the tree-lined streets of DHA Lahore to the coastline of DHA Karachi and the planned sectors of Islamabad, we map every city, society, block and property into one navigable, data-rich platform.

Our catalogue is organised as a strict hierarchy — City → Housing Scheme / Society → Block / Zone / Area → Property — so buyers can zoom from a national overview down to a single plot. Every entity carries GIS coordinates, master-plan layers, imagery, floor plans, amenities and multimedia.

Behind the listings sits an analytics core: geographic search, points and areas of interest, valuation and ROI models, double-entry accounting, a CRM pipeline and multi-factor forecasting — all exposed through an open MCP and REST API.
bullets: Verified listings with documented title checks
GIS master-plan mapping and polygon search
Instant valuation, ROI and future-price forecasts

mission.title: Our Mission & Values
mission.subtitle: Making property decisions transparent and data-driven
body: We exist to remove the guesswork from Pakistani real estate. Every price, yield, distance and forecast shown on the portal is backed by data and a method behind it — never an unsupported claim.
We believe a family buying its first home deserves the same analytical rigour as an institutional investor, and that trust is the only sustainable currency in this market.
bullets: Transparency — sources, assumptions and methods are always visible
Accuracy — valuations reconciled against comparables and rent rolls
Inclusion — affordable housing and low-cost finance are first-class citizens
Responsibility — verified titles and clean documentation

services.title: What We Offer
services.subtitle: End-to-end property services
services.summary: From discovery to handover and beyond.
body: Whether you are buying, selling, renting, investing or developing, the portal carries you through the whole lifecycle with tools for each stage.
bullets: Advertising desk for builders, material suppliers and service providers

how-it-works.title: How It Works
how-it-works.subtitle: Four steps from search to keys
body: Watan-e-Pak follows a simple, repeatable path so nothing is left to chance.

faqs.question: Do I need an account to browse?
faqs.answer: No. Browsing and maps are open; an account (verified by mobile or e-mail OTP) unlocks saved searches, offers and messaging.

faqs.question: How are prices validated?
faqs.answer: Prices are reconciled against comparable listings, recent transactions and rent rolls, and flagged when a listing deviates sharply from the market band.

faqs.question: Can I book a site visit?
faqs.answer: Yes — every listing page lets you request a visit, which the CRM routes to the assigned agent with a scheduled slot.

careers.subtitle: Build the future of Pakistani real estate with us

construction.title: Construction Wing
construction.subtitle: Techniques, cost analysis, estimation & building codes
construction.summary: Estimate build cost, compare techniques and follow the codes with one engine.
body: The construction wing turns a plot and a brief into a defensible build cost. It carries a catalogue of construction techniques — from conventional RCC frames and load-bearing masonry to steel, pre-engineered buildings, precast, tunnel formwork and ICF — each scored on cost, speed, soil and seismic suitability.

A parameterised estimator builds the cost up element by element (substructure, frame, masonry, roofing, finishes, MEP and external works), then adds preliminaries, contingency, consultancy and contractor overhead & profit, and returns a phase timeline and a material take-off. Rate analysis shows the material, labour and plant split inside every BOQ line.

Because construction choice is an investment decision, the wing also models the impact on real-estate value, rent and payback, and it gathers the applicable codes and byelaws (zoning, setbacks, FAR, structural, seismic, fire, accessibility, environmental) with the full NOC / approval workflow.
bullets: Element-wise cost estimate with contingency, consultancy and margin
Rate analysis and material take-off from covered area
Technique comparison by cost, unit rate and build speed
Impact of build quality on value, rent and payback

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions we hear most
body: Everything you need to know about listings, verification, finance and the API.

faqs.question: How do I verify a listing?
faqs.answer: Verified listings display a badge; their title, developer NOC and plot dimensions have been checked against society records.

faqs.question: Which areas do you cover?
faqs.answer: Currently Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad and Rawalpindi, with schemes, blocks, properties, points of interest and master plans modelled for each.

faqs.question: Can I get a mortgage through the portal?
faqs.answer: Yes. We surface bank and SBP-subsidised home-finance offers and provide a mortgage calculator with amortisation schedules.

faqs.question: Is there an API?
faqs.answer: Yes — every capability is exposed over both MCP (for AI agents) and REST (for applications), backed by the same logic.

faqs.question: Do you support Urdu?
faqs.answer: Fully. The portal renders right-to-left in Urdu and can be switched between languages and light/dark themes at any time.

maintenance.title: Maintenance Wing
maintenance.subtitle: Services, lifecycle, condition & cost after handover
maintenance.summary: Plan preventive maintenance, budget repairs and protect asset value.
body: The maintenance wing looks after a building after handover. It catalogues the maintainable components — structure, envelope, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, finishes, lifts and external works — with their expected service life, replacement cost and inspection frequency.

It produces a preventive-maintenance calendar, an annual cost estimate with a category breakdown, a multi-year capital-replacement reserve study, and repair-versus-replace analysis for ageing components. A defect catalogue covers the problems Pakistani buildings actually suffer: seepage, dampness, cracks, corrosion, electrical faults and termites.

Finally, it quantifies the real-estate impact of maintenance — a well-maintained asset sells and lets faster, commands a higher rent and retains tenants longer, so maintenance is treated as an investment, not a cost.

agentic.title: Agentic OS
agentic.subtitle: An AI agent layer over one shared data layer
agentic.summary: Buyer, seller, broker, landlord and investor agents — planned, audited, human-approved.
body: The Agentic Operating System turns the portal from a search tool into an agent that understands a goal and acts on it. Product agents — a conversational homebuying agent, a seller pricing & marketing agent, a broker workspace, an investment screener, an autonomous leasing agent, a marketing conductor and two MCP products — act across the CRM, the ledger, GIS, leasing and marketing on one shared data layer.

Every autonomous step is planned first, bound to a real portal tool and gated for human approval where the agent is not fully autonomous. The full run — steps, outputs and approvals — is recorded as an audit trail, so an agent's work is as traceable as a human's.
Because the same tools are exposed over MCP, an external AI client (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) can drive the very same agents — the 'MCP for brokers' loop.
bullets: Plan → execute → review → deliver with approval gates

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.subtitle: The deal-to-close lifecycle, wired to the ledger
transactions.summary: Offers, contract terms, deadlines, e-signatures, commission and revenue share.
body: The transaction module is the moat: it links the deal-to-close lifecycle directly to the financial ledger. A transaction carries its milestone and deadline checklist from offer acceptance through KYC, title search, due diligence, financing, signing, NOC and closing.

Contract terms are extracted from agreement text, offers are negotiated and countered, e-signatures are tracked to completeness, and on close the commission and VAT are allocated across the platform, listing agent and selling agent — the balanced journal entry is posted and the payouts recorded, all in one step.
bullets: Milestone/deadline tracking with RAG status

leasing.title: Autonomous Leasing
leasing.subtitle: 24/7 inquiry handling, screening and renewals
leasing.summary: Answer tenants across every channel, screen applicants and never let below cost.
body: The autonomous leasing agent holds 24/7 conversations across web chat, WhatsApp, SMS, e-mail and voice — answering availability, price, amenity, commute and schools questions and pre-screening applicants in minutes.

A rent floor derived from each unit's holding cost guarantees a unit is never let at a loss. Screening weighs income-to-rent, references, a behavioural credit proxy and employment into an approve / conditional / decline decision, and the renewal agent recommends renewal rents while protecting good tenants.

tools.subtitle: Calculators · GIS · CAD · photo · documents · calendar
tools.summary: Free professional property tools: calculators, mapping, conversion and the Pakistan & Islamic calendar.
body: The Tools & Utilities center turns the portal from a listings site into a working professional toolkit. It offers property and finance calculators, a plot & construction studio, GIS measurement and georeferencing, CAD/plan utilities, photo geotagging, document conversion, the Pakistan & Islamic calendar and a reports/export studio.

Every tool runs on the same engine in the MCP server and the REST API, so the answers are identical whichever way you call them. Tools that genuinely need a heavy or licensed dependency (GDAL, PyMuPDF, Tesseract, DWG conversion) say so instead of pretending to do the work.

pmo.title: Projects & Monitoring
pmo.subtitle: Plan · schedule · track · control — in-house PMO
pmo.summary: Run the portal's own projects: WBS, critical path, earned value, cost and risk control, site diaries and a live RAG dashboard.
body: The Projects & Monitoring (PMO) wing is the in-house project-management, monitoring and tracking system for the developments the portal itself delivers. It keeps a project register and a weighted work-breakdown, then runs a forward/backward scheduling pass over the task network to produce float, the critical path and a Gantt plan on a six-day (Mon–Sat) working week.

Progress is duration-weighted and earned value follows the standard definitions (PV, EV, AC, SV, CV, SPI, CPI, EAC, ETC, VAC, TCPI), so cost and schedule performance are always visible. A monitoring layer turns that into schedule, cost, risk and quality RAG status with an exception-based alert engine and a portfolio dashboard.

Around the core sit the controls a project office actually runs on: a RAID register with a probability × impact matrix, daily site diaries, variation requests with cost and schedule impact, stage inspections scored into a quality index, meeting action items, resource loading and full status reports as JSON or printable HTML.

It mines dormant and previously-lost leads for false negatives and drafts reactivation outreach, generates listing copy, social posts, reels and market reports (human-approved before publishing), and plans multichannel campaigns with budget allocation and KPIs.

messaging.subtitle: Conversations tied to properties, plans, customers and tasks
messaging.summary: An internal team workspace: direct messages, team channels and a discussion panel on every property record, with e-mail and optional Telegram alerts.
body: The Team Messaging wing is the portal's internal communication system. It keeps the team's conversations inside Watan-e-Pak and tied to the work itself: direct messages, group discussions and channels such as Sales, Property Verification, GIS & Mapping, Customer Support and Management, plus an internal discussion panel on every property record so a listing, its map, its documents and its follow-up tasks stay in one place.

Messages support threaded replies, @mentions, pins, reactions, search, unread counts and read receipts. Files are shared as references — a controlled storage key or a link to an existing portal record — and handed out through permission-checked, expiring links, so large plans and PDFs never sit inside chat text.

Any message can be turned into a tracked action: a task, an approval, a property verification or a follow-up, with an owner and a deadline. A notification queue with per-user, per-category preferences (in-app, e-mail and optional Telegram) keeps everyone informed without making e-mail or Telegram the system of record; Telegram alerts carry only short text and an authenticated deep link, never confidential documents.

pages.title: Construction Wing
pages.subtitle: Techniques, cost analysis, estimation & building codes
pages.summary: Estimate build cost, compare techniques and follow the codes with one engine.
body: The construction wing turns a plot and a brief into a defensible build cost. It carries a catalogue of construction techniques — from conventional RCC frames and load-bearing masonry to steel, pre-engineered buildings, precast, tunnel formwork and ICF — each scored on cost, speed, soil and seismic suitability.

A parameterised estimator builds the cost up element by element (substructure, frame, masonry, roofing, finishes, MEP and external works), then adds preliminaries, contingency, consultancy and contractor overhead & profit, and returns a phase timeline and a material take-off. Rate analysis shows the material, labour and plant split inside every BOQ line.

Because construction choice is an investment decision, the wing also models the impact on real-estate value, rent and payback, and it gathers the applicable codes and byelaws (zoning, setbacks, FAR, structural, seismic, fire, accessibility, environmental) with the full NOC / approval workflow.

faqs.answer: Fully. The portal renders right-to-left in Urdu and can be switched between languages and light/dark themes at any time.

pages.title: Maintenance Wing
pages.subtitle: Services, lifecycle, condition & cost after handover
pages.summary: Plan preventive maintenance, budget repairs and protect asset value.
body: The maintenance wing looks after a building after handover. It catalogues the maintainable components — structure, envelope, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, finishes, lifts and external works — with their expected service life, replacement cost and inspection frequency.

It produces a preventive-maintenance calendar, an annual cost estimate with a category breakdown, a multi-year capital-replacement reserve study, and repair-versus-replace analysis for ageing components. A defect catalogue covers the problems Pakistani buildings actually suffer: seepage, dampness, cracks, corrosion, electrical faults and termites.

Finally, it quantifies the real-estate impact of maintenance — a well-maintained asset sells and lets faster, commands a higher rent and retains tenants longer, so maintenance is treated as an investment, not a cost.

pages.summary: Buyer, seller, broker, landlord and investor agents — planned, audited, human-approved.

Product agents — a conversational homebuying agent, a seller pricing & marketing agent, a broker workspace, an investment screener, an autonomous leasing agent, a marketing conductor and two MCP products — act across the CRM, the ledger, GIS, leasing and marketing on one shared data layer.

Every autonomous step is planned first, bound to a real portal tool and gated for human approval where the agent is not fully autonomous. The full run — steps, outputs and approvals — is recorded as an audit trail, so an agent's work is as traceable as a human's.
Because the same tools are exposed over MCP, an external AI client (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) can drive the very same agents — the 'MCP for brokers' loop.

Contract terms are extracted from agreement text, offers are negotiated and countered, e-signatures are tracked to completeness, and on close the commission and VAT are allocated across the platform, listing agent and selling agent — the balanced journal entry is posted and the payouts recorded, all in one step.

pages.title: Projects & Monitoring
pages.subtitle: Plan · schedule · track · control — in-house PMO
pages.summary: Run the portal's own projects: WBS, critical path, earned value, cost and risk control, site diaries and a live RAG dashboard.
body: The Projects & Monitoring (PMO) wing is the in-house project-management, monitoring and tracking system for the developments the portal itself delivers. It keeps a project register and a weighted work-breakdown, then runs a forward/backward scheduling pass over the task network to produce float, the critical path and a Gantt plan on a six-day (Mon–Sat) working week.

Progress is duration-weighted and earned value follows the standard definitions (PV, EV, AC, SV, CV, SPI, CPI, EAC, ETC, VAC, TCPI), so cost and schedule performance are always visible. A monitoring layer turns that into schedule, cost, risk and quality RAG status with an exception-based alert engine and a portfolio dashboard.

Around the core sit the controls a project office actually runs on: a RAID register with a probability × impact matrix, daily site diaries, variation requests with cost and schedule impact, stage inspections scored into a quality index, meeting action items, resource loading and full status reports as JSON or printable HTML.

pages.summary: An internal team workspace: direct messages, team channels and a discussion panel on every property record, with e-mail and optional Telegram alerts.
body: The Team Messaging wing is the portal's internal communication system. It keeps the team's conversations inside Watan-e-Pak and tied to the work itself: direct messages, group discussions and channels such as Sales, Property Verification, GIS & Mapping, Customer Support and Management, plus an internal discussion panel on every property record so a listing, its map, its documents and its follow-up tasks stay in one place.

Messages support threaded replies, @mentions, pins, reactions, search, unread counts and read receipts. Files are shared as references — a controlled storage key or a link to an existing portal record — and handed out through permission-checked, expiring links, so large plans and PDFs never sit inside chat text.

Any message can be turned into a tracked action: a task, an approval, a property verification or a follow-up, with an owner and a deadline. A notification queue with per-user, per-category preferences (in-app, e-mail and optional Telegram) keeps everyone informed without making e-mail or Telegram the system of record; Telegram alerts carry only short text and an authenticated deep link, never confidential documents.

/messaging/overview.principle: Keep business conversations and records inside Watan-e-Pak; use e-mail for formal communication and Telegram for optional alerts or quick coordination.

config.disclaimer: Notifications are queued and written to the outbox by the in-process dispatcher; a production deployment runs the same queue from a background worker and hands e-mail/Telegram payloads to a provider. Telegram and e-mail payloads never carry attachments or confidential document content - only short text and an authenticated deep link.

rollout: 1. Internal messaging - direct messages, channels, property discussions, unread counts, file sharing
2. E-mail notifications - invitations, mentions, assignments, approvals, important updates
3. Optional Telegram bot - per-user opt-in per notification category
4. Workflow automation - summarise conversations, extract action items, route leads, reminders
/messaging/overview.storage_note: In-memory stores behind the _store seam. The brief is explicit that these must not be the permanent message store: move to a PostgreSQL messaging schema plus private object storage with expiring links before production.

techniques.name: RCC frame (cast-in-situ)

pros: Easy to extend or modify later
cons: Material wastage and site quality risk
